KISWAHILI — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. When practising Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
